title: The Total Economic Impact of JFrog Software Supply Chain Security
study_context: Composite organization based on interviews with five JFrog customers

composite.deployment: SaaS enterprise tier; hybrid cloud and on-premises applications

faster_vulnerability_remediation.source_formula: vulnerabilities remediated × 4 hours saved × $87/hour × (1 - 5% risk adjustment)

developer_onboarding.source_formula: developers onboarded × 38 hours saved × $87/hour × (1 - 5% risk adjustment)

applicability_note: These are results for Forrester's composite organization, not observed or projected results for solenglatest. Customer projections require customer-supplied baselines, costs, adoption coverage, and realization factors.
